summary: A radiofrequency (RF) microneedling treatment used for texture, scarring and pore concerns.
leadAnswer: Microneedling at Kaiteki is usually radiofrequency (RF) microneedling: fine needles deliver radiofrequency energy at set depths to prompt a controlled skin-renewal response. The doctor chooses one of three devices and sets needle depth and energy for each area after assessing your skin.
seoTitle: RF Microneedling Malaysia | Potenza, Morpheus8 | Kaiteki
seoDescription: RF microneedling in Malaysia for texture, acne scarring and pore concerns using Potenza, Morpheus8 or Sylfirm X. Book a free consultation at Kaiteki.
typicalSessions: A course, spaced a few weeks apart

facts.label: Matched to your concern and skin
Before a treatment of around 20 to 40 minutes
Your first visit is a doctor consultation, not a treatment

routes.title: Depressed scarring, texture and enlarged pores
routes.body: Often the starting point for rolling and boxcar scarring.

routes.title: Etched lines and overall texture
routes.body: Considered for static lines and general texture, where the aim is collagen through the deeper skin rather than relaxing movement.

variantModule.heading: Morpheus8, Sylfirm X or Potenza: which device, and why
variantModule.intro: Kaiteki offers three RF microneedling devices with different reach and RF modes.

items.title: Morpheus8
items.body: Designed for deeper RF penetration, and generally considered for skin tightening along the jaw and neck.

items.title: Sylfirm X
items.body: Delivers RF in pulsed and continuous modes, and is generally considered for melasma, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation and redness.

items.title: Potenza
items.body: Adjustable needle depth with monopolar and bipolar RF modes, generally considered for acne scarring, enlarged pores and oily texture.

ctaMid.heading: Not sure which of the three devices suits your skin?
ctaMid.body: Scarring, pores, pigment and firmness call for different devices and depths. A doctor can tell you which you are dealing with.

avoidIf.lead: Active skin infection, acne flares or inflamed areas

avoidIf.body: or other medications your doctor goes through with you.

avoidIf.lead: A pacemaker or other implanted electronic device,
avoidIf.body: metal implants or permanent fillers in the treatment area, which must be declared.

bringToConsult: Recently tanned or sunburnt skin may mean postponing.

sessionSteps.title: Consultation and assessment
sessionSteps.body: A doctor reviews your skin and medical history and chooses the device and settings.

sessionSteps.title: Numbing
sessionSteps.body: Numbing cream is applied for around 30 to 45 minutes, which is much of the appointment.

sessionSteps.title: The treatment
sessionSteps.body: Needle depth, energy level and pattern are adjusted to your skin, and many people describe the sensation as mild heat and pressure.

sessionSteps.title: Afterwards
sessionSteps.body: The skin is cooled and soothed, and you are given aftercare guidance.

bands.title: The first one to two days
bands.body: Some redness is common, and the skin can look flushed and feel warm, often with a faint grid pattern from the needle tips.

bands.title: The following days
bands.body: Some dryness or light flaking afterwards can be normal. Deeper settings can leave the skin flushed and tender for slightly longer, and pinpoint scabs can occur.

afterSession.aftercare: Sun protection and gentle skincare while the skin settles, with retinoids and acids usually paused for a short period.

risks.common: Redness, swelling, sensitivity, dryness, pinpoint bruising or scabbing, and temporary changes in skin appearance.
risks.lessCommon: Infection, prolonged pigment change or scarring.
risks.pigmentNote: Radiofrequency is not absorbed by melanin the way laser light is, so RF microneedling is used across a broad range of skin tones, including deeper Asian skin. Temporary pigment change is still possible, particularly with deeper settings or poor sun protection afterwards.
cannotDo: It is not a substitute for surgery where there is significant sagging or excess skin.
Scar work is staged. Different scar types respond differently, and no single session is a fix.
It does not settle melasma for good. Melasma is chronic and relapsing, and needs ongoing topical care and sun protection alongside any procedure.
risks.disclose: Tell your doctor about anything in the list under who should postpone or avoid it, even if it seems minor.

costFactors.intro: Kaiteki does not quote prices online, because the device, area and plan are set at consultation. What moves it:
factors: Which device your doctor selects for your concern.
The size of the area treated.
The number of sessions in the course.

relatedReasons.pico-laser: Considered where the concern is pigment rather than texture or scarring.
relatedReasons.skin-booster: Injectable hydrating treatments used to support skin quality and hydration, where an injectable rather than a device is the route.

sections.heading: What is RF microneedling?
body: RF microneedling refers to a group of treatments that combine traditional microneedling with radiofrequency (RF) energy.

sections.heading: How does RF microneedling treat several depths in one session?
body: The needles create controlled micro-injuries, then release radiofrequency energy as heat from their tips. Because needle depth and energy are adjustable, several skin depths can be treated in one session. The combination is intended to prompt the skin's repair and collagen-remodelling response over time, and the extent of any change varies between individuals.

faqs.q: Which device is right for me: Morpheus8, Sylfirm X or Potenza?
faqs.a: As a general guide, Morpheus8 is associated with deeper skin tightening, Sylfirm X with pigment and redness, and Potenza with scarring and pores.
Some redness for one to two days is common, and mild dryness or flaking can follow.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: Usually a course of sessions spaced a few weeks apart.
